CXLCCIDevice.title: CXL Type3 CCI Device
CXLCCIDevice.description: Configuration for a CXL Type 3 device managed by ccid via CCI over MCTP. The ccid daemon reads the MCTP Event Notification policy and applies it to the device.

Name.description: Unique name for this CXL device configuration

MCTPEventInterruptPolicy.description: 16-bit MCTP Event Notification settings mask sent with CCI Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy (0x0105). Bits 0-3 enable the Informational, Warning, Failure and Fatal event logs; 15 (0x000F) enables all four. Bit 4 (Dynamic Capacity) is ignored: ccid leaves that log to the host.
